findings.claim: `export interface JsonSchema` is removed entirely rather than re-exported, which is a breaking change for any consumer importing `JsonSchema` from this module.
findings.rationale: The interface was explicitly `export`ed, so it is part of the package's public type surface. The replacement `SchemaObject` is imported with `import type ... from './types'` and is not re-exported here, so `import { JsonSchema } from '.../generate'` now fails. If backwards compatibility matters, add `export type { SchemaObject as JsonSchema }` or a deprecated alias. High confidence this changes the exported API; severity depends on whether the package is published.

findings.claim: Swapping `JsonSchema` for OpenAPI `SchemaObject` may silently drop support for the JSON-Schema-only keywords the old type carried (`$defs`, `$schema`, `prefixItems`, `items: false`).
findings.rationale: The old local interface explicitly modelled `$defs`, `$schema`, `prefixItems`, and `items?: JsonSchema | false` — all things a Zod/JSON-Schema converter emits. If `SchemaObject` in `./types` is a stricter OpenAPI 3.1 shape without these, code downstream that reads/writes `schema.$defs` or assigns `items: false` will now fail to type-check, or (worse) be force-cast and lose data at runtime. Medium confidence — depends on the definition in `./types`, which is not visible in this hunk.
